clue.text: Means hail storms may be seen

parts.note: Ave is the Latin greeting, as in Ave Maria
storms as a verb, rages furiously

explanation.surface: A forecaster's remark that hailstorms can be expected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Means' looks like a verb but is the plural noun for typical values; 'hail storms' is split into two separate pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Statistical means are arithmetic averages, the typical values of a set of figures.

clue.text: Fresh meat sailors swallowed

indicators.note: the meat takes the sailors inside it, as if eating them

parts.note: veal is the meat of calves
RN, the Royal Navy, stands for sailors

explanation.surface: Seamen tucking into a supply of freshly delivered meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Vernal describes springtime, the season of freshness and new growth.

clue.text: Tracks of birds

definitions.meaning: railway lines run on steel bars laid as track
a family of marsh birds, like the water rail

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher identifying footprints left in the mud.
explanation.definitionFit: One word covers both the bars a train runs on and a family of wading birds.

clue.text: Huge beast that's best seen through a telescope

parts.note: great means huge
a bear is a beast

explanation.surface: A large animal one should watch only from a safe distance, through a telescope.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests safari caution; the 'beast' is in fact a constellation, Ursa Major.
explanation.definitionFit: Ursa Major is a constellation, a star pattern that astronomers observe in the night sky.

clue.text: Subordinate theme

definitions.meaning: a subordinate person is under another's rule, as a monarch's citizen is
the topic or matter under discussion

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a person ruled by a monarch and the topic of a discussion.

clue.text: Club well-qualified people run

parts.note: MAs are holders of a Master of Arts degree
hie is an old word meaning hasten or run

explanation.surface: Graduates managing a society of their own.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Club' suggests a society, but it is a golf club; 'run' looks like 'manage' but means hurry.
explanation.definitionFit: A mashie is an old-fashioned iron used in golf, roughly a modern five-iron.

clue.text: Means of communication for TV detective

definitions.meaning: Inspector ..., hero of the ITV detective series set in Oxford

explanation.definitionFit: Samuel's dot-dash code shares its name with Colin Dexter's Oxford policeman, star of a long-running British TV series.

clue.text: Many Nazis were armed with these

definitions.text: Many Nazis were armed with these

parts.words: Many Nazis were armed with these
parts.note: 'armed' suggests weapons, but the reference is to emblems worn on armbands

explanation.surface: A historical note about the weaponry carried by German soldiers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'armed' is read as wearing on the arm: the hooked-cross badge was worn on Nazi armbands.
explanation.definitionFit: The hooked cross was the Nazi party emblem, displayed on members' armbands.

clue.text: Shame nothing's admitted in disastrous mining year

indicators.note: the zero is let into the jumbled word, placed within it
a disastrous outcome leaves things in chaos, so the letters of mining are scrambled

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A colliery disaster and the disgrace of officials who admit no fault.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disastrous' is the anagram signal, not a description of the year; 'admitted in' lets the zero into the scrambled letters before the year's Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Ignominy is public disgrace or dishonour, a synonym for shame.

clue.text: A turbulent river reach

indicators.note: turbulent water is churned up, so the letters of river are thrown about

explanation.surface: A stretch of rough river water, a reach being a stretch of river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reach' poses as a noun for a river stretch, but it is the verb; 'turbulent' rearranges RIVER into RRIVE.
explanation.definitionFit: To reach a place is to get there, the same as arriving at it.

clue.text: Publican's profits — they're cheap at the price

parts.note: a publican runs a pub, whose bar is his business
gains are profits

explanation.surface: A pub landlord's takings, coming from cheap drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods worth more than one pays for them are good deals, items cheap for their value.

clue.text: Recorder involved in test case

indicators.note: involved means intricate or tangled, so the letters of test case are mixed together

explanation.surface: A court recorder, a part-time judge, sitting on a legal test case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Recorder' suggests a judge; here it is a tape that records sound.
explanation.definitionFit: A tape cassette is a medium that holds a recording of sound.

clue.text: Put in grave — wrong note given to doctor!

indicators.note: something wrong is out of order, so the letters of note are rearranged

parts.note: MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A doctor's fatal error after a mistaken prescription note.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay a body in a tomb is to bury it, placing it in its resting place.

clue.text: Stunning, but also inspiring

definitions.meaning: literally drawing in air, taking a breath

explanation.surface: Praise for something that is both beautiful and uplifting.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means awe-inducing and, read literally, drawing air into the lungs.

clue.text: Topping dormitory feast

parts.note: a dormitory is a place of beds, suggesting bed
a spread is a lavish meal

explanation.surface: A midnight feast in a school dorm, which is topping, old slang for excellent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Topping' looks like schoolboy slang praising the feast, but it is the definition: what goes on top of a bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A coverlet laid over the top of a bed is its uppermost layer.

clue.text: Thanks to natural evolving, it has a maddening bite

parts.note: ta is British informal for thank you

indicators.note: evolving means changing form, so the letters of natural develop into a new order

explanation.surface: Natural evolution has given some creature a bite that drives victims mad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'evolving' rearranges NATURAL into RANTULA; the bite was once blamed for tarantism, a frenzied dancing mania.
explanation.definitionFit: This large spider's bite was traditionally believed to cause a manic dancing frenzy.

clue.text: New director, one yet to be paid

indicators.note: something new is made afresh, so the letters of director are formed into a fresh word

explanation.surface: A newly appointed director who has not yet received a salary.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone owed money is waiting to be paid back what they lent.

clue.text: Business figures showing what happens after slump

definitions.meaning: official statistics on imports and exports
after a slump, commerce comes back

explanation.surface: Economic data showing a recovery after a downturn.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names official commerce statistics and, read literally, commerce coming back.

clue.text: Strong man, one wedded to a queen

parts.note: a titan is a person of great strength, after the Greek giants
one is I, the Roman numeral

explanation.surface: A muscleman who has married a queen.
explanation.definitionFit: In A Midsummer Night's Dream she is the fairy queen, wife of Oberon.

clue.text: Key operators may strike against it

definitions.text: Key operators may strike against it

parts.words: Key operators may strike against it
parts.note: 'strike against' suggests industrial action by key workers, but typists' keys hit the roller

explanation.surface: Essential workers threatening a strike over some grievance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Key operators' are typists, not vital staff; on a typewriter the keys strike the paper against a roller.
explanation.definitionFit: On a typewriter, the cylinder behind the paper takes the impact of the typebars.

clue.text: Fashions suitable to be shown in commercials

indicators.note: the suitable word is displayed within the commercials, placed inside them

parts.note: ads are advertisements, commercials
apt means suitable

explanation.surface: Clothing deemed suitable for display in advertisements.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fashions' looks like a noun for clothes but is a verb meaning shapes.
explanation.definitionFit: To fashion something is to shape or modify it, to make it fit a purpose.

clue.text: One way to shoot game

definitions.meaning: to fire from a hidden position
a wading bird shot for sport

explanation.surface: Advice on how to bag game birds.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both firing from cover, like a sniper, and a long-billed game bird.

clue.text: Substantial list includes cocktail of gin

indicators.note: the list holds the mixed letters inside it

parts.note: a table is a list of data

indicators.note: a cocktail mixes ingredients, so the letters of gin are shaken up

explanation.surface: A long drinks menu that features gin cocktails.
explanation.walkthrough: 'list' looks like a drinks menu, but it gives a table of data; 'cocktail of' is the anagram signal on the spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: Something real enough to be touched is solid and material, not imaginary.

clue.text: Flower head of hydrangea from Limerick, say

parts.note: the iris is a flower

indicators.note: the head of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A gardener's note on a hydrangea variety from County Limerick.
explanation.walkthrough: Limerick is a county and city in Ireland, not a verse form here.
explanation.definitionFit: Limerick is in Ireland, so anyone from there is of that nation, 'say' marking it as an example.

clue.text: Capital fellow from Greece

parts.note: 'capital fellow' sounds like old praise for a good chap, but means a native of the Greek capital

explanation.surface: Praise for a splendid Greek man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' is old slang for excellent, but here it refers to Athens, the capital of Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Athens, the Greek capital city, is called by this demonym.

clue.text: Buy tie to get dressed up, being in a particular place

indicators.note: dressing up changes appearance, so the letters of buy tie take on new form

explanation.surface: Shopping for a tie to look smart for an occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: This rare philosophical term denotes the state of having a location, of being somewhere.

clue.text: It gives you a walkover in game

definitions.meaning: a structure you walk across over a river or road
the card game for four players in partnerships

explanation.surface: A game in which one side wins easily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'walkover' suggests an easy win, but it is a crossing to walk over.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a span over an obstacle and the partnership card game.

clue.text: A striking defeat that's humiliating

parts.note: a bashing is a heavy thrashing or defeat

explanation.surface: A heavy defeat that leaves the losers embarrassed.
explanation.definitionFit: To abash someone is to make them ashamed or embarrassed, so humbling them.
